test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A part of the following sentence is underlined. Choose the option which can replace the underlined part to improve the sentence. In case Options A, B and C are not found suitable, choose Option D: “No Improvement Required.”

The review panel concluded that the policy was **__replete in inconsistencies and therefore required__** immediate revision.

options.text: replete with inconsistencies and therefore required
replete of inconsistencies and therefore requiring
replete by inconsistencies and therefore requires

solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The phrase "**replete in inconsistencies**" is incorrect usage in English grammar.
 
• The correct preposition to use with "**replete**" is "**with**," as it indicates abundance or being full of something.
 
• The sentence should read "**replete with inconsistencies**" to convey the intended meaning correctly.
 
• Options **2** and **3** use incorrect prepositions ("**of**" and "**by**") and verb forms, making them grammatically incorrect.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"The review panel concluded that the policy was **replete with inconsistencies**__ and therefore required immediate revision."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "**replete of inconsistencies and therefore requiring**" is incorrect as "**replete**" does not pair with the preposition "**of**."
 
• **Option 3:** "**replete by inconsistencies and therefore requires**" is incorrect because "**replete**" does not pair with the preposition "**by**."
 
• **Option 4:** "**No improvement required**" is incorrect because the original sentence uses "**replete in inconsistencies**," which is grammatically incorrect.
